title: Run the deferred checks on refactor once Jeb is ready to merge it
body:
While dev keeps moving in the week of 2026-11-10, Jack asked to keep the checks on refactor to the suite, fmt and clippy. The rest waits until Jeb says he is ready to merge refactor into dev. At that point, run all of these against the branch as it stands.

- The benchmark suite before and after every change that touched the hot loops this week, the removal of the N-run shortcut from `find_lcp` among them: release build, 4 threads, 5 repeats, medians, as `CLAUDE.md` asks.
- Every commit on refactor past `origin/dev` builds and passes `cargo test --workspace`, so the history bisects.
- On catalyst, build hg38, hs1 and uniprot_sprot with dev and with refactor, unmasked and under a seed mask, and compare the `.sufr` hashes. Any difference is either explained by a commit or is a bug.
- The NEON port in refactor's `lcp.rs`, checked on an Apple silicon machine: the suite, `lcp` against `lcp_scalar` over every mismatch position and the cache probe points, and byte-identical output against an x86 build of the same commit.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/b57eb726
notes.text:
Jeb plans to squash-merge refactor, so the per-commit build-and-test check is dropped.

At refactor 453e2d0 against dev 657e16d on catalyst: `cargo fmt --check` is clean, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` gives 4 warnings, and `cargo test --workspace --release` passes.

suffix-bench `measure` with `-n 2000`, no cap and no `--dna`, through the wrapper `vendor/sufr/sufr-refactor-453e2d0` (it moves `-t` after the subcommand and drops `-m 0`). Medians of wall time and peak RSS:

| input | threads | runs | dev | refactor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| easy | 4 | 5 | 10.7 s, 318 MB | 2.6 s, 318 MB |
| withn | 4 | 5 | 10.7 s, 318 MB | 2.6 s, 318 MB |
| sim1clone | 4 | 5 | 1.0 s, 66 MB | 0.8 s, 49 MB |
| amino | 4 | 5 | 10.4 s, 318 MB | 2.6 s, 318 MB |
| chr1 | 4 | 5 | 30.2 s, 782 MB | 31.5 s, 934 MB |
| uniprot_sprot | 4 | 5 | 19.7 s, 474 MB | 8.1 s, 520 MB |
| hg38 | 32 | 3 | 131.5 s, 9638 MB | 93.2 s, 12021 MB |

Every `.sufr` matched dev byte for byte: the seven above, and at 32 threads hg38 `-d`, hg38 `-d -s 1110111`, chr1 `-d -i`, and uniprot_sprot with `--write-lcp`, `-s 11011` and `-s 11011 --write-lcp`.

Not run yet: hs1, and the NEON check on Apple silicon.
